blurb: Guests can book tee times with dynamic pricing and a 14-day booking window. Junior golf programs include various classes and camps for ages 3 to 15, focusing on skills and golf virtues. The club also offers private golf lessons and hosts weddings and special events with indoor and outdoor venues.
extraNote: Cancellations more than 24 hours in advance are fully refundable; 24-12 hours get a rain check; less than 12 hours no refund or rain check · All credit card transactions subject to 3% convenience fee · Rainchecks issued at sole discretion of management; course deemed playable by superintendent · No returns or exchanges on e-gift cards; e-gift cards not redeemable for cash
